edges.reason: transfer delegates to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to internal _transfer.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance checks.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender.
manualswap authorizes caller against dev/marketing addresses using msg.sender.
manualsend authorizes caller against dev/marketing addresses using msg.sender.
setTrading onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
blockBots onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
unblockBot onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
setFee onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
setMaxTxnAmount onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
setMaxWalletSize onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
renounceOwnership onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
transferOwnership onlyOwner modifier compares _owner to msg.sender.
_transfer triggers an external swap-and-send flow during the token transfer.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router's fee-supporting swap.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
Router swap consumes the block.timestamp deadline argument.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to fees after swapping.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to the marketing address.
manualswap calls the internal swap routine.
manualsend calls the internal ETH disbursement routine.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router state variable.
sendETHToFee sends funds to the marketing address state variable.
_transfer reads the fee-exclusion mapping to decide fee application.
_transfer gates transfers on the tradingOpen flag.
_transfer enforces the max transaction amount.
_transfer enforces the max wallet size.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and receiver.
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard.
_transferStandard reads computed values from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits team tokens via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies fee reflection via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard mutates the _rOwned reflection balances.
_takeTeam adds reflected team tokens to contract balance.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_getValues reads current dynamic fee values.
owner view returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
transferOwnership records the previous owner.
setFee writes the buy/sell fee configuration variables.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom directly feeds the internal _transfer accounting.
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth is consumed by the router swap call inside the function.
The amount parameter of sendETHToFee is forwarded directly into the ETH transfer operation.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer used to decide the swap.
contractETHBalance is a temporary holding the ETH that is passed to sendETHToFee.
